source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Move, Charge rolls and Advance rolls can each ignore some or all modifiers for EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units in your army. The WARLORD’s unit begins as your Favoured Champions. On either player’s turn, the first enemy unit killed by attacks from one of your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units triggers the handover. Once all those attacks resolve, that unit takes over as Favoured Champions. Attacking models in your army’s Favoured Champions unit may take a Wound roll again.

favouredChampions.replaceAt: after all the triggering unit’s attacks resolve
favouredChampions.trigger: first enemy unit destroyed by a friendly Emperor’s Children Character unit in each player turn
